name: Bunticore
source:
Bunticore its a small visual novel about a strange mix between a deer and a bunny named Jas, he seems to be going through some troubles in his life and you are the only one that could help him feel better with himself, or not!
However... Something strange happens once you met him, you seem to be able to get inside his nightmares and help him beat his internal problems!

[From [url=https://jazzedp.itch.io/bunticore]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Bunticore》是一部小型视觉小说，讲述了一只鹿和一只名叫Jas的兔子的奇怪组合，他似乎在生活中遇到了一些麻烦，而你是唯一可以帮助他自我感觉良好的人，或者不是！
然而……当你遇见他时，奇怪的事情发生了，你似乎能够进入他的噩梦并帮助他克服内心的问题！

[来自[url=https://jazzedp.itch.io/bunticore]Itch.io[/url]]
